en.headline: Police charge 19-year-old student over four mortgage scams totaling HK$3.4 million
en.dek: Yau Tsim officers said the university student posed as a law firm employee, was recruited via Threads for HK$750 per job, and will appear at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts today.
body: Police have charged a 19-year-old university student over four alleged mortgage scams that together involved about HK$3.4 million. Inspector Frankie Chiu of the Yau Tsim police district said the man was arrested on Monday after a victim reported the incident.

According to police, the victim received a cold call last month from someone posing as a bank representative offering a low-interest home mortgage with large cash rebates. The victim was later told to meet a person claiming to be a law firm staff member at Elements shopping centre in West Kowloon.

The suspect showed a fake staff identity card and asked the victim to sign documents and transfer HK$800,000 as proof of funds. The victim later checked with the institutions and reported the matter to police the same day. Officers arrested the student on suspicion of obtaining property by deception and possession of false instruments.

Further investigation linked him to at least three similar cases. Police said the student was recruited through a Threads post and received HK$750 per assignment via mule accounts. He has been charged with two counts of obtaining property by deception and one count of possession of a false instrument, and is due to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts today.
Police urged the public to verify the identity of anyone claiming to represent a bank or law firm, and to call the Anti-Deception Coordination Centre hotline 18222 if in doubt.

zh.headline: 警方起訴19歲大學生涉四宗按揭騙局共約340萬元
zh.dek: 油尖警區指該名男學生假扮律師樓職員，透過Threads被招攬每次獲750元報酬，今日在九龍城裁判法院提堂。
body: 警方已起訴一名19歲男大學生，涉四宗虛假樓宇按揭計劃騙案，總金額約340萬元。油尖警區刑事支援隊督察丘逸龍表示，男子於周一被拘捕，案件源自一名受害人報案。
警方指，受害人上月接獲自稱銀行職員的來電，對方以低息樓宇按揭及高額現金回贈作招徠。受害人其後按指示於西九龍圓方商場與自稱律師樓職員的男子會面。
被捕人出示虛假職員證，要求受害人簽署文件並轉賬80萬元作為資金證明。受害人事後向相關機構查證後報警。警方同日以涉嫌以欺騙手段取得財產及管有虛假文書拘捕該名學生。
進一步調查發現他另涉至少三宗同類案件。警方稱該學生透過Threads帖文被招攬，每次犯案只獲750元報酬。他已被暫控兩項以欺騙手段取得財產及一項管有偽造文書罪，今日在九龍城裁判法院提堂。
警方呼籲市民接到自稱金融機構或律師行職員的推銷電話時應核實身分，如有懷疑可致電防騙易熱線18222。
